map.录入馆藏总量、年度借阅量、注册读者与到馆人次，汇总利用率、周转率、人均借阅与人均: Enter total collection, annual loans, registered readers and visits; summarize utilization rate, turnover rate, per-capita loans and per-capita visits and other collection-usage report metrics for annual business statistics and collection development decisions. Utilization rate = loan copies ÷ collection copies × 100%; turnover rate = loan copies ÷ collection copies. Computation is done locally in the browser, no data uploaded to the server.

map.流通率 = 年借阅册次 ÷ 馆藏总册数 × 100%；读者人均借阅 = 年借阅册: Circulation rate = annual loan copies ÷ total collection copies × 100%; per-capita reader loans = annual loan copies ÷ registered readers; visit rate = annual visits ÷ registered readers; new-acquisition ratio = annual new collection ÷ total collection copies × 100%; book turnover days = 365 ÷ (loans ÷ holdings, decimal rather than percentage); year-over-year change rate of each metric = (this-year value − last-year value) ÷ last-year value × 100%, used for horizontal and vertical comparison of collection use efficiency.

map.录入馆藏总册数、年度借阅册次与注册读者数，汇总馆藏利用率、周转率、周转天数与读者: Enter total holdings, annual loans and registered readers to summarize collection utilization, turnover rate, turnover days and loans per reader, for annual reporting and collection development.
map.结合年度到馆人次计算读者人均到馆与单次到馆借阅，观察馆藏被实际使用的强度，而不只: Use annual visits to compute visits per reader and loans per visit, showing how intensively the collection is actually used rather than looking only at total loans.
map.录入年度新增馆藏并查看新增占比，把当年补充量与利用率放在一起，判断馆藏增长是否带: Enter annual new acquisitions and review their share alongside utilization, to see whether collection growth translates into higher circulation.
map.某馆馆藏 120000 册、年度借阅 96000 册次、注册读者 8000 人、: A library holds 120,000 books with 96,000 annual loans, 8,000 registered readers, 150,000 annual visits and 6,000 new books. Following the tool: utilization = 96,000 ÷ 120,000 = 80%; turnover = 0.8 times per book; turnover days = 365 ÷ 0.8 (decimal, not 80) = 456.3 days; loans per reader = 96,000 ÷ 8,000 = 12, visits per reader = 150,000 ÷ 8,000 = 18.75, loans per visit = 96,000 ÷ 150,000 = 0.64; new acquisitions share = 6,000 ÷ 120,000 = 5%.
map.利用率、周转率和周转天数是什么关系？: How are utilization, turnover rate and turnover days related?
map.利用率 = 年度借阅册次 ÷ 馆藏总册数 × 100%，比如 80%；周转率是同: Utilization = annual loans ÷ total holdings × 100% (e.g. 80%); turnover rate is the same ratio as a decimal (e.g. 0.8 times per book), meaning each book is borrowed 0.8 times a year on average. Turnover days = 365 ÷ decimal turnover (365 ÷ 0.8 = 456.3 days) - use 0.8, not 80, otherwise you would get 4.6 days.
map.人均借阅和单次到馆借阅分别看什么？: What do loans per reader and loans per visit measure?
map.人均借阅 = 年度借阅册次 ÷ 注册读者数，衡量每位登记读者一年借多少册；单次到: Loans per reader = annual loans ÷ registered readers (how many books each registered reader borrows per year); loans per visit = annual loans ÷ annual visits (how many books are lent per visit). The first denominator is the number of readers, the second is the number of visits - one person visiting repeatedly makes visits larger than readers, so do not mix them up.
map.录入馆藏总量、年度借阅量、注册读者与到馆人次，汇总利用率、周转率、人均借阅与人均: Enter total holdings, annual loans, registered readers, and visits to summarize holdings-utilization report indicators such as utilization rate, turnover rate, loans per reader, and visits per reader for annual business statistics and collection-development decisions. Utilization rate = loans ÷ holdings × 100%, turnover rate = loans ÷ holdings.
map.借阅册次/馆藏比 = 年借阅册次 ÷ 馆藏总册数 × 100%（重复借阅会重复计: Loans / holdings = annual loans ÷ holdings × 100% (repeat loans are counted repeatedly, so it can exceed 100%); collection utilization = distinct items loaned at least once ÷ holdings × 100% (enter the distinct-item count); loans per reader = annual loans ÷ registered readers; visits per reader = annual visits ÷ registered readers; new-item share = annual new items ÷ holdings × 100%; turnover days = 365 ÷ (loans ÷ holdings, as a decimal not a percentage); year-over-year change = (current − prior) ÷ prior × 100%.

map.某馆馆藏 120000 册、年度借阅 96000 册次、注册读者 8000 人、: A library has 120,000 holdings, 96,000 annual loans, 8,000 registered readers, 150,000 visits and 6,000 new items. Loans/holdings = 96,000 ÷ 120,000 = 80%; if 72,000 distinct items were loaned at least once, collection utilization = 72,000 ÷ 120,000 = 60%; turnover = 0.8 loans/item and 365 ÷ 0.8 = 456.3 days (use the decimal 0.8, not 80); loans per reader = 12, visits per reader = 18.75, loans per visit = 0.64; new-item share = 5%.
map.借阅册次/馆藏比 = 年度借阅册次 ÷ 馆藏总册数 × 100%，比如 80%，: Loans/holdings = annual loans ÷ holdings × 100% (80% here); repeated loans of one item are counted repeatedly. Turnover is the same ratio as a decimal (0.8 loans/item). Collection utilization needs distinct items loaned at least once ÷ holdings, so enter that item count; do not substitute annual loans. Turnover days = 365 ÷ 0.8 = 456.3, using 0.8 rather than 80.
map.单次到馆借阅 = 年度借阅册次 ÷ 年度到馆人次，衡量每次到馆平均借出多少册；到: Loans per visit = annual loans ÷ annual visits; when visits are 0 it is not calculable.

Loans/holdings = loans ÷ holdings × 100% (repeat loans can push it above 100%); collection utilization needs the distinct items loaned at least once. Everything runs locally in the browser.
